purpose: Complete frozen NT coverage for all segments of the existing processed HPRC R2 graph, enabling subsequent complete-bubble context experiments without replacing any benchmark cache.
scheduling: After the complete masked-feature campaign releases all four GPUs; wait while another process uses more than 256 MiB on any assigned GPU. Fail on a failed dependency or after 12 hours waiting.
preprocessing: Unchanged manuscript cache contract: maximum 6000 raw bases via balanced ends; 1000 tokens; final-layer non-special-token mean; frozen parameters; offline model reuse.
validity: Require exact canonical graph IDs, matching graph/model/preprocessing hashes, finite float32 vectors, and byte-identical preservation of all original serialized vectors. No biological labels used.
scope: Representation infrastructure only: no new graph download, no retraining, no biological performance claim, and no substitution into active or completed experiments. Current pathless SV graph remains pathless.
